In exactly 60 minutes, I experienced the best mech combat game in vr of my life time, I'm deeply afraid of hitting ♥♥♥♥ in my room, I'm throwing dogs and smashing bugs, I'm SLAUGHTERING hundreds at the last few breaths of my mechanized …

The fact that this isn't an advertised launch title for the frame is an atrocity. This is amazing. it's a shame they didn't do launch titles. The game isn't just "giant robot fight" the mechanics are legitimately unique and fun. …
Honestly lots of really neat stuff in this game. It sucks that I can't stand the Gorilla Tag Style movement. I won't be that guy and demand that they add a different movement style. …
好玩！ 但是制作组能不能出一个针对游玩空间较小的模式。 不要那么多怪物出口，让怪物都从正面出来，我一转身一圈打后面的柜子上了。。。哭。
美术风格很不错，我平时不听黑哥们念经都觉得很酷。音效很不错，打击感很到位。 也有些缺点： 1. 抓握灵敏度感觉太高了，想微调距离总是移动过头，或者莫名其妙把自己蹭到场景陷阱里。 2. …
